regime_context: The TSX thematic detector shows Base Metals & Copper as the prevailing narrative with strong momentum rank and full breadth, alongside a durable trend gate. Backtest indicates the absolute-trend gate aids risk control, not return forecasting; any lean is a conditional overweight for drawdown-aware positioning, not a prediction. Macro backdrop dominated by AI tech and geopolitical news adds noise to sector rotations.
emerging_watch: Gold Miners (XGD.TO) challenging for leadership. Watch for XGD.TO 10-day relative outperformance over XBM.TO exceeding 2% as a confirmatory handoff signal; if that occurs, the Base Metals overweight thesis would be retired in favor of a new assessment. Until confirmed, no action.

theses.subject: Base Metals & Copper
theses.thesis: Base Metals & Copper holds the top rank with high breadth, durability bar above 0.7, and the absolute trend gate active, suggesting trend health and volatility containment. The overweight lean is a risk-managed bet on continuation of the prevailing theme, conditional on the trend gate remaining intact.
evidence: Eligible under absolute trend gate, which backtests show reduces tail risk
theses.dissent: Base metals are highly linked to global macro demand (especially China), and the unscheduled news share (0.99) implies unpredictability; a sudden growth scare or risk-off event could reverse the trend quickly, and momentum itself lacks predictive alpha.

falsifier.text: XBM.TO underperforms S&P/TSX Composite by 5% over the next 20 trading days.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
